title: A day in one place
premise: Sunrise to night in one location. Chronological, so it survives a flat track — the story carries it instead of the drop.

copy.hook: 24 hours in the same square mile

shots.what: The most striking single frame of the whole day, out of order
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Break chronology once, here only. Open with your best frame and then go back to the beginning — nobody watches a sunrise they were not promised something for.

shots.what: First light. Empty streets, mist, the place before anyone is in it.
shots.subject: none
shots.shoot: Tripod. Hold ten seconds so the editor can find a slow drift inside it. Shoot before you think you need to.

shots.what: The place waking up — shutters, coffee, first people
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: One slow pan across the activity. Do not chase things; let them cross the frame.

shots.what: One small thing — hands, steam, a stray animal
shots.subject: none
shots.shoot: Details are what stop a travel reel reading as a postcard. Shoot twice as many as you think you need.

shots.what: Full daylight, the place at its busiest
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Walk through it with the camera at chest height. The one point in the day where movement and noise are the subject.

shots.what: You in it — walking, sitting, eating
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Set the camera down and walk into frame. A day reel without a person in it is stock footage.

shots.what: Golden hour. The light doing the work.
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Twenty minutes before sunset, not at it. Shoot into the light with something solid in the foreground. This is the frame the reel is remembered for.

shots.what: After dark — lights, reflections, the place emptied again
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Find a light source in frame and expose for it. Handheld will be noisy — brace against something.

shots.what: Back to the opening frame, now at night — the loop
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Same position and framing as shot 1. Matching the first and last frame is what makes the loop invisible.
